description:
The proposed works involve modifications to the existing dormer window located above the bathroom on the first floor at the rear of the property. The key changes include:
1.	Enlargement of Dormer Window: The existing dormer window will be extended to provide improved natural light and ventilation to the bathroom.
2.	Alteration of Roof Structure: Adjustments to the roof structure will be made to accommodate the enlarged dormer. This includes changes to the pitch and materials to ensure consistency with the existing roof.
3.	Integration with Party Wall: As the property is a terraced house, the construction will involve work on the shared party wall with the adjoining property. All necessary measures will be taken to ensure compliance with the Party Wall Act 1996, including serving notice to the neighbour and obtaining any required agreements.
4.	External Appearance: The dormer extension will be finished with materials that match the existing exterior to ensure visual harmony with the surrounding properties. This includes matching tiles/slates, window frames, and external cladding.
5.	Structural Integrity: Professionals will be involved to ensure that all modifications maintain the structural integrity of both the property and the adjoining properties.
